hooks.name: Walnut stitches tests on stitch edit
hooks.description: After the agent saves a file under stitch_walnut/, src/walnut/ or vendor/walnut/, run the pytest suite (which includes the vendored-bytes check, so any edit to the vendored Walnut engine fails at once) and the Walnut wiring tests. Needs a Python with pydantic and PyYAML: `python` on PATH, or STITCH_PYTHON (honoured by scripts/pytest.mjs). Shell command, so it costs no credits.
